name: Bladebound Warmage (Warmage Archetype)
body:
Some warmages are chosen to bear the black blade-a sentient weapon of often unknown and possibly unknowable purpose. Who chose them or why is a mystery, but the black blade is a powerful tool. As a black blade becomes more aware, its true motivations manifest, and as does its ability to influence its wielder with its ever-increasing ego.

Black Blade (Ex)

At 3rd level, a bladebound warmage gains a powerful sentient weapon called a black blade, whose weapon type is chosen by the bladebound warmage. A warmage with this class feature cannot take the familiar arcane strategy, and cannot have a familiar of any kind, even from another class. For details on what weapons the black blade may be and how it progresses, see the bladebound magus archetype. This ability replaces the arcane strategy gained at 3rd and 19th levels and focused mind.
